title: Import and export
description: Add lessons to the corpus or download it as a file for the mobile app.

safe.title: Imports never overwrite what exists
safe.body: Only what is missing is added. A lesson or module that already exists (same identifier) is skipped and your changes stay intact. Added lessons arrive as drafts.

syllabus.title: Full syllabus
syllabus.body: Creates the structure of the official syllabus: domains, modules and lesson titles. Lesson content is still to be written.
syllabus.present_one: {{count}} syllabus lesson already in the corpus
syllabus.present_other: {{count}} syllabus lessons already in the corpus
syllabus.confirmBody: {{domains}} domains, {{modules}} modules and {{lessons}} lessons will be added if they do not exist yet. Nothing that exists will be changed. New lessons arrive as drafts, without content.

seed.title: Starter corpus
seed.body: The lessons from the first version of TACTIC, with their modules. Only titles and settings are imported, not the content.
seed.present_one: {{count}} starter lesson already in the corpus
seed.present_other: {{count}} starter lessons already in the corpus
seed.confirmBody: {{lessons}} lessons and {{modules}} modules will be added if they do not exist yet. Nothing that exists will be changed. New lessons arrive as drafts.

file.title: JSON file from your computer
file.body: A file exported from this page, or a corpus in the same format. You will see what gets added before confirming.
file.errorTitle: This file could not be read
file.errorJson: The file is not valid JSON. Check that it is a TACTIC export.
file.errorEmpty: No lessons or modules found in this file.
file.errorSize: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.
file.errorRead: The file could not be opened. Try another file.

preview.title: Preview before import
preview.drafts: Added lessons arrive as drafts: review them before publishing.
preview.detached_one: {{count}} lesson points to a module that cannot be found. It will be imported without a module.
preview.detached_other: {{count}} lessons point to a module that cannot be found. They will be imported without a module.
preview.duplicates_one: {{count}} duplicate item in the file is counted once.
preview.duplicates_other: {{count}} duplicate items in the file are counted once.
preview.nothing: Everything in this file already exists. There is nothing to add.

export.heading: Export
export.body: The corpus in the mobile app format, to bundle into the app or keep as a backup. The app can also read published lessons directly online.
export.includeDraftsHint: Off: only published lessons and their modules are exported.
export.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Use “Download the file” instead.
export.previewTruncated: Preview limited to the first {{count}} characters. The full file is {{size}}.
export.emptyBody: The corpus has no lessons. Import the syllabus or the starter corpus above.
export.emptyPublished: No published lessons. Turn on “Include drafts” to export the whole corpus.

loadError.title: The corpus could not be loaded
loadError.body: Imports and export are unavailable until the corpus loads, so nothing gets miscounted.
